historyMethod: Paginated workflow_dispatch history; unique run IDs. Workflow success does not establish input mode, production effect or current state. No live D1/Notion access. Offline literal npm references are candidates for parity, not verified equivalent runtime coverage.
policy: Keep manual-only operational workflows outside new PR CI. No active workflow is deleted or disabled without proven replacement and separate production approval. Existing source history is preserved in Git, no redundant YAML copies.
